directFacts: The documented input value is NSString with TRUE/FALSE spellings.
The key is optional. Omission defaults to false for the explicit version0 used here; the version1-without-Max-Age exception is not this path.
The linked property documentation accepts NSDate or NSString for expires; the current absolute Date assignment is retained.
The Cocoa construction uses NSDate for an actual expires value.
It sets NSHTTPCookieDiscard to NSNumber true only inside the session condition; no false assignment is made for persistent cookies.

diagnosisBoundary: Actual fb6 output proves the parsed persistent seed has an expiry and is not session-only, while our rebuilt object loses expiry and becomes session-only.
